The Mental Health (MH) Clinical Operations Manager (COM) is located in the Mental Health Service under the Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program (BHIP) Program Manager at VA Northern California Health Care System.

The COM works in close collaboration with the MH Management Team to facilitate the logistical and operational needs across MH programs at their site. The Chico COM directly supervises a workforce of BHIP employees at the Chico and Yuba City clinics.

The COM helps to ensure that the Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program BHIP Team meets the overall performance standards, measures, and mission of the VA and the BHIP Program.

The COM ensures timely, integrated, efficient and effective delivery of MH services across the continuum of care for Veterans who are served at the Chico and Yuba City sites.

Duties for the position may include but are not limited to: Ensures efficient delivery of services related to BHIP program, involving both day-to-day operations and long-term planning and growth; Provides oversight to BHIP team operations in order to assure comprehensive provision of collaborative care; Provides local operational oversight around utilization, bookability, and performance metrics, assures grid accuracy and maintains DSS mapping to meet programmatic expectations; Supervises BHIP multidisciplinary staff, which may include psychiatrists, psychologists, advanced practice nurses, social workers, peer specialists, and program support assistants; Hires and trains all BHIP staff at as assigned site; Establishes guidelines and performance expectations for staff, which are clearly communicated through the formal employee performance management system; Provides feedback and periodically evaluates employee performance throughout the year; Resolves informal complaints and grievances; develops work improvement plans, recommending personnel actions as necessary; Effects disciplinary measures as appropriate to the authority delegated in this area; Reviews and approves or disapproves leave requests; Establishes and monitors clinic profiles in terms of availability, utilization and scheduling, and staff productivity; Attends site management meetings and serves as a liaison with delegated authority as needed to address site specific operational concerns; Works with the facility management to maintain a clear understanding of policy and up to date procedures concerning local safety issues, disaster planning, and related preparedness concerns; Communicates with other MH Managers and MH Administrative Officer regarding any space needs or issues at a given site.

This includes acting as the MH POC and MH liaison, directing issues to and reporting back from the appropriate authority; Coordinates with and serves as MH liaison to Telehealth, BDMS, Clinical Informatics, IT and other services as needed in order to facilitate efficient clinical operations and address local problems across programs; Completes assigned Performance Improvement activities at the program, service line and medical center level; Coordinates with facility management to assure that engineering and physical plant concerns are addressed in a timely manner; Provides public relations and community outreach and education regarding VA care to various social agencies, medical/primary care, legal, housing, and welfare organizations; Participates in root cause analysis and addresses action plan items related to patient safety and patient care issues.

Provides specialized psychological services at all levels of complexity for patients, with service delivery to include intake evaluation, diagnostic assessments, psychotherapy and patient education; Assesses and diagnoses mental disorders and conducts specialized psychological and/or cognitive function assessments and neuropsychological screenings; Treats mental disorders through a variety of modalities (and especially EBPs), and provides adjunctive interventions for treatment of medical disorders; Provides a full range of therapeutic interventions including individual and group psychotherapy, family therapy, consultation, rehabilitation and psychoeducation; Participates on selection panels for Staff Psychologist position vacancies or other positions as assigned by Chief MHPL.

Education: Doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a respecialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the respecialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: the respecialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the respecialization program, which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship. OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Exception: Non-licensed applicants who otherwise meet the eligibility requirements may be given a temporary appointment as a "graduate psychologist" at the GS-11 or GS-12 grade under the authority of 38 U.S.C. 7405 [(c)(2)(B)] for a period not to exceed two years from the date of employment on the condition that such a psychologist provide care only under the supervision of a psychologist who is licensed.

Failure to obtain licensure during that period is justification for termination of the temporary appointment.

# **Chef de projets industrialisation (H/F) H/F** #
## Description du client ##
Flexsis accompagne les talents en Suisse en leur proposant des opportunités en adéquation avec leurs compétences et leur expérience. Grâce à une approche humaine, exigeante et à des outils digitaux performants, nous valorisons chaque parcours et facilitons l'intégration des candidates et candidats au sein d'équipes dynamiques, engagées et attachées à l'excellence.
Dans le cadre de ses activités de développement, notre client, entreprise de renom basée dans la région biennoise et spécialisée dans la production horlogère, recherche un Chargé de projet industrialisation (H/F) pour un poste fixe.
## Description du poste ##
Dans cette fonction, vous jouez un rôle central dans le passage des projets de développement à la production série. Vous définissez les process de fabrication pour les projets d'industrialisation en vous assurant de leur conformité avec les standards internes, les exigences qualité et les objectifs de performance attendus.
Vous analysez les besoins de production, les contraintes techniques ainsi que les flux de fabrication afin de proposer des méthodes industrielles robustes, fiables et adaptées à l'environnement horloger. Vous participez à la sélection des moyens de production, à la formalisation des gammes opératoires et à la mise en place des paramètres nécessaires au bon déroulement des opérations.
Vous êtes également responsable de l'estimation des temps de fabrication et de la validation de la performance des process en termes de prix, de qualité et de délai. À ce titre, vous contribuez à sécuriser les objectifs industriels et à anticiper les éventuels écarts de performance.
Vous suivez les phases de présérie afin de vous assurer du bon fonctionnement des process définis, de leur stabilité et de leur robustesse en conditions réelles de production. Vous identifiez les axes d'amélioration, pilotez les ajustements nécessaires et coordonnez les actions correctives avec les différents interlocuteurs concernés.
En parallèle, vous animez et coordonnez les équipes impliquées tout au long de la phase de production. Vous veillez à la bonne circulation des informations, à la priorisation des actions et au suivi rigoureux des rectifications à mettre en œuvre. Vous jouez un véritable rôle de liaison entre les équipes techniques, la production, la qualité et les autres services partenaires.
Par votre implication, vous garantissez la cohérence industrielle des projets confiés, tout en assurant un accompagnement structuré jusqu'à la mise en production optimale.
## Profil recherché ##
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation de Technicien ET ou d'un titre jugé équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans une fonction similaire, idéalement en tant que chef de projets industrialisation, au sein d'un environnement industriel exigeant.
Vous possédez de très bonnes connaissances de la fabrication et des produits mécaniques horlogers. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à l'industrialisation, à l'optimisation des processus, à l'analyse des temps de production et au suivi de performance. Une bonne compréhension des problématiques qualité, coûts et délais constitue un atout essentiel pour réussir dans cette fonction.
Vous êtes reconnu pour votre esprit d'initiative, votre sens de l'organisation et votre rigueur. Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle, structurer vos priorités et avancer avec méthode dans un environnement où la précision est primordiale.
Doté d'un excellent sens de la communication, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés. Votre facilité d'adaptation vous permet d'évoluer efficacement au sein d'un contexte technique et dynamique, tout en trouvant rapidement des solutions concrètes face aux imprévus.
Nous vous offrons un cadre de travail moderne et dynamique, des conditions attractives ainsi qu'un accueil et un suivi personnalisé de votre dossier en toute confidentialité.

Das Personalamt des Kantons Zürich ist zuständig für alle personal-, arbeits- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen der über 30'000 Mitarbeitenden des Kantons Zürich. Die Abteilung Human Resources Management (HRM) beinhaltet eine grosse Anzahl an Aufgaben und ist Teil des Personalamts. HR-Beratung, Berufliche Grundbildung, Employer Branding und Case Management stehen im Mittelpunkt der Arbeit.
**Berufliche Grundbildung bedeutet Zukunft gestalten.**
Jedes Jahr starten rund hundert Lernende in 25 Lehrberufen ihre Ausbildung beim Kanton Zürich. Hinter jeder Lehrstelle steht die Chance, Jugendliche auf ihrem Weg ins Berufsleben zu begleiten und gleichzeitig die Fachkräfte von morgen auszubilden.
Die Berufliche Grundbildung im Personalamt ist zusammen mit dem Berufsbildungsforum für die strategische Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung im Kanton Zürich zuständig - von der Definition von Standards und Prozessen, der Weiterentwicklung des Lehrstellenangebotes sowie gemeinsamen Projekten und Veranstaltungen.

Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlagen dafür, dass der Kanton Zürich seine Vorbildrolle in der Berufsbildung weiter ausbaut und auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.
Diese neu geschaffene Funktion bietet dir die einmalige Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine direktionsübergreifende Strategie und Konzepte, schaffen neue Perspektiven und prägen die Nachwuchsförderung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich. Die Stelle ist im Rahmen eines Projekts bis Ende 2029 befristet.
### Wie kannst du dich einbringen? ###
* Strategien entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit den Direktionen und Fachbereichen entstehen Konzepte und Strategien (u.a. Lehrstellenförderung, Aufbau der SOG\[AB4.1\], Weiterbeschäftigung von Lehrabgänger/innen, Lehrbetriebsverbundmodelle sowie Lehrberufsverantwortliche) für die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung.
* Projekte zum Erfolg führen: Von der Idee über die Roadmap bis zur Umsetzung verantwortest du anspruchsvolle Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Ergebnisse werden.
* Netzwerke aufbauen: Du arbeitest direktionsübergreifend mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen zusammen, berücksichtigst unterschiedliche Interessen, präsentierst Lösungsansätze
* Entscheidungsgrundlagen schaffen: Analysen, Trends und deine Handlungsempfehlungen bilden die Basis für strategische Entscheide und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung.
* Berufsbildung weiterdenken: Du erkennst Chancen für neue Ausbildungsmodelle, stärkst bestehende Angebote und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen, damit der Kanton Zürich auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.
### Wer bist du? ###
* Berufsbildung begeistert dich: Du kennst die berufliche Grundbildung aus eigener beruflicher Erfahrung und möchtest sie aktiv mitgestalten.
* Strategisch denken. Praktisch umsetzen: Du entwickelst tragfähige Konzepte und verlierst dabei nie die Umsetzung aus den Augen.
* Menschen verbinden: Unterschiedliche Interessen bringst du zusammen und überzeugst durch Klarheit, Diplomatie und ein sicheres Auftreten - auch in einem politischen Umfeld.
### Was bieten wir dir? ###
* Zukunft gestalten: Mit deiner Arbeit entwickelst du die Berufsbildung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich weiter und hinterlässt nachhaltige Spuren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Dich erwartet eine neu geschaffene Funktion mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, spannenden Stakeholdern und der Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung aktiv mitzugestalten.
* Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und ein Arbeitsplatz in Gehdistanz zum Zürcher Hauptbahnhof bieten dir optimale Rahmenbedingungen.
### Was jetzt? ###
Wir haben dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen. Bitte beachte, dass wir nur Bewerbungen bearbeiten, welche über unser Online-Tool eingehen.

s.t:
Real people. Real service. At  SupplyHouse.com , we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first.

Led by our core values of G enerosity, R espect, I nnovation, T eamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential.

As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers. We are looking for a Program Manager, Fulfillment Operations to join our corporate Operations Team.

This individual will report into our Manager of Program Management and lead critical facility buildout and automation initiatives across SupplyHouse's fulfillment network.

They will own end-to-end project execution for new FC launches, relocations, and automation system deployments, coordinating closely with Operations, IT, Finance, and external vendors to deliver on scope, schedule, and budget.

If you have a strong background in warehouse operations, capital project management, or supply chain engineering and thrive in a highly cross-functional environment with significant ambiguity, we’d love to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states:  Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position will require travel up to 15% of the year, including to our Melville, NY headquarters up to 3 times per year for internal meetings and team-building activities, as well as travel to our on-site fulfillment locations.

We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open. Role Type:  Full-Time, Exempt Location:  Remote Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility Base Salary:  $82,000 – $103,000 per year Responsibilities:
Lead project planning and execution for large-scale fulfillment center buildouts, including greenfield facility launches and FC moves from inception through go-live
Own end-to-end coordination of automation system deployments (goods-to-person, conveyor/sortation, WMS integration) in partnership with automation vendors and internal IT
Define project scope, milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics; maintain detailed project plans and hold workstream owners accountable to timelines
Partner closely with internal teams (Operations, Supply Chain, IT, Finance, HR, etc.) to align project objectives and drive seamless execution
Partner with Operations, Finance, and Real Estate to develop and maintain capital and labor models supporting facility investment decisions
Manage vendor relationships and deliverables across automation, construction, and equipment partners; escalate risks and hold vendors to contractual commitments
Facilitate cross-functional communication across Operations, Supply Chain, IT, and Finance to ensure alignment on project status, risks, and decisions
Identify and mitigate project risks; proactively surface issues to leadership with clear options and recommendations
Conduct post-launch performance reviews to validate throughput, labor, and cost assumptions against design targets; feed lessons learned into future facility design
Support continuous improvement initiatives across the fulfillment network in partnership with the CI team
Develop and maintain operational and financial models (volume projections, labor planning, capacity utilization) to support facility design and investment decisions
Serve as a liaison between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders to ensure clear communication and expectations
Build and maintain performance measurement programs for automation systems across the fulfillment network, translating system data into actionable operational reporting
Lead ROI tracking and validation for automation investments, including methodology development and ongoing reporting
Own continuous post-launch performance measurement, including tracking actuals vs. design targets, managing an improvement backlog, and driving accountability across operations, vendor, and leadership teams

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or related field
3+ years of program management experience in a supply chain, fulfillment, warehouse operations, or related distribution/logistics field
Experience managing large-scale capital programs/projects ($5M+) including vendor contracts and equipment procurement
Experience managing cross-functional projects with simultaneous workstreams across Operations, IT, Finance, and external partners

Direct on-site fulfillment or warehouse operations experience
Experience with greenfield facility buildouts or large-scale FC relocations
Familiarity with WES/WCS integration and automation vendor management
Experience with project management tools and methodologies (PMP, Agile, or equivalent)
Experience in e-commerce or distribution environment
Experience building KPI frameworks or performance dashboards in a fulfillment, warehouse, or distribution environment
Experience working with WES, WCS, or WMS data to support operational reporting
Proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent)

s.h: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab
s.t:
Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.
Schritt 2: Gespräche
Im Vorstellungsgespräch \- telefonisch, vor Ort oder online \- möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.
Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess
Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe\- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.
Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.
Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.
We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

The Senior Program Manager, Professional Services for Defense and Intelligence is an experienced technologist who guides the strategy and execution of one or more teams across multiple projects or workstreams. They are an exemplary team leader who works with customers to make them successful users of Planet’s product offerings at a global scale.
This role provides leadership and technical oversight for the Professional Services team, independently identifying and tackling projects that solve open-ended, ambiguous problems to lead global customer engagements to successful outcomes.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or London office 3 days per week.

Structure the team so the right people are in the right roles and plan for long-term headcount and recruiting needs to guarantee the success of the organization.

Attract and hire a diverse and talented team with a broad range of experiences and strengths, keeping in mind the long-term health of the global org.

s.h: 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary
s.t:
As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.
This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform .
You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.
Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:
Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?
Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?
Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?
Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution .
🚀 What you'll own
Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.
Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.
Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.
Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.
Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.
Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.
Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.
Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.
Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.
Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.
Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

s.h: Review and interpret customer technical documentation including
s.t:
Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
Network and communications diagrams
Site and asset specifications
PPC and controller documentation
Modbus register maps
IP addressing and network information
Functional Design Specifications
Metering and telemetry information

Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.
Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.
Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.
Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.
Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:
Gateway installation and connectivity
Operational acceptance testing
Kraken market and service testing
Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.
Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.
Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

Position Description
The Deployment Project Manager is a pivotal, execution-focused role responsible for advancing Oklo ’s mission to deliver clean, affordable, and reliable energy. This individual owns the end-to-end delivery of one or more highly complex powerhouse projects, from design integration and site development through construction, startup, commissioning, and turnover to operations.
These multi-year, non-recurring projects include significant first-of-a-kind scope, substantial commercial value, evolving risks, and complex dependencies across internal teams, external partners, regulators, and other key stakeholders.

The Deployment Project Manager serves as the central point of coordination, driving integrated planning, decision-making, risk management, and clear communication among project teams, executive leadership, and external parties.

Success in this role requires a strategic and hands-on leader with a startup mindset - someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, operate effectively in a resource-constrained environment, and maintain momentum, accountability, and alignment throughout the full project lifecycle.
Location: Remote, with 25%–40% travel required

Lead end-to-end execution of powerhouse facility deployments from design through startup and turnover to operations.
Support and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and execution tools to monitor progress and drive delivery.
Identify, manage, and escalate risks, issues, dependencies, and changes to protect critical path, licensing, regulatory, and commercial objectives.
Lead project governance routines, including status reviews, stage-gate reviews, and executive reporting.
Manage project scope, risks, issues, and dependencies while proactively identifying and implementing mitigation strategies.
Communicate project status, recommendations, and strategic insights to stakeholders ranging from project teams to executive leadership.
Support permitting, licensing, facility modifications, equipment installations, and infrastructure upgrade projects.
Oversee contractor performance, procurement activities, material sourcing, and project deliverables.
Serve as the primary point of coordination among internal teams, customers, contractors, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
Contribute to technical strategy, execution planning, and continuous improvement initiatives that support organizational goals.
Ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and operational requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Nuclear Engineering, Business, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience leading complex technical, engineering, construction, manufacturing, or operational projects.
Experience managing project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, milestones, and cross-functional dependencies.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, resolve blockers, and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to operate with agility and sound judgment in a fast-moving, evolving organization.
Proficiency with project planning, scheduling, and collaboration tools.
Nuclear experience in design, construction, commissioning, or operations

Experience managing contractor-driven projects, capital projects, facility upgrades, or equipment installation efforts.
Familiarity with quality assurance, configuration management, permitting, or regulatory compliance processes.

## Your Purpose ##
The LNG Manager is responsible for inspecting the construction and outfitting of the related LNG equipment and that fitting is done according to international regulation, ship-s contract, technical specifications, and builder standards.

This role is controlling the quality of the materials used, the compliance with regulation and with IGF Code and highlighting any discrepancies within the approved project.

Potential adjustments when minor technical issues are identified by this role, during the construction phase, may be recorded and shared within the Site team and new building division as lesson learnt to be implemented on next projects.

* Ensures that areas under the described discipline are built within the set timescale and in line with the approved technical design, contractual requirements, and functional requisites.
* Follows the installation and outfitting of all LNG equipment and piping maintaining accurate and up to date records of all activities and inspections.
* Attends project meetings and prepares progress reports.
* Ensures that all commissioning activities are held in accordance with the scope and the specifications, are approved by class and relevant authorities such us Flag and USCG representatives.
* Suggests minor adjustments as may be found necessary on site and follows implementation and development of any architectural / technical design change.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the approved design that can be improved for future constructions.
* Involves the Technical Site Specialist(s) during the construction and commissioning phase to ensure that technical accessibility and functionality of equipment is duly verified.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the ship-s design and technical features that might jeopardise the functional requisites and must be improved for the current project or can be improved for future constructions with new building department approval.
* Assists with Plan Approval activities as required.

* Fluency in English, knowledge of Italian or French is a plus.

* Substantial experience with delivering inspections of technical areas on ship-s building and or refitting projects or onboard cruise vessels in operations.
* Good knowledge of IGF Code.
* Good knowledge of piping, electrical machinery inspection is a plus as she/he may be requested to cooperate with the technical teams for the daily inspections included within the ship-s construction.
* Experience in a leadership position on board LNG vessels or cruise ships with LNG duty might be beneficial.
* Proficiency with the use of Microsoft Office (including Excel, MS Word, MS Project or equivalent and PowerPoint);
* Familiarity with Marine Rules and International Standards and Regulations.
* Ability to review new building specifications and to read and understand a variety of engineering drawings.
* Ability to review RCA and technical reports to ensure lesson learnt and their application during construction.

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets.

Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.
The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program.

These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer.

Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built.

You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there.

You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.
This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

· Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
· Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
· Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
· Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
· Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter.

After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

The AMXL Customer Experience and Growth team takes a 360-degree approach to the customer journey:
· **Eliminate**: detect, solve, and resolve customer-impacting issues upstream by providing relevant and timely insights for operations teams, transportation, and product development.
· **Automate**: continuously assess and identify opportunities to replace manual processes with automated, scalable solutions.
· **Optimize**: when a customer does need support, ensure AMXL stakeholders have the tools, resources, policies, and protocols to deliver a perfect experience.
The operations center translates strategic decisions into daily network performance. The proactive execution team ensures that when defects occur, customers are protected through early intervention. The Sr. Program Manager will be the link that makes both teams operate as one system.
